title: The AI World
tagline: While everything is created by AI, how the world will be like?
description: In the past year, AI is getting hotter than ever, and so as its arguments. We believe that forbidding AI is not realistic, instead, AI-helped creation will become common in the future. In this work, we're creating a world with resources, the inputs to an AI model, and models. By limiting the resources, inputs turn scarce. It provided another economics that controls the supply and demand of inputs. The ways to create a resource are "discover" and "generate". "Discover" means that it finds some way to produce a desired result from a black box. For example, someone "discover"s the word "apple" from keccak256. "Generate" means that someone uses its inputs and an AI model to produce a desired result. That is to say that "generate" mechanism empowers the resource cycle in the world.
how_its_made: This project is built on the top of OP Stack, in order to make the chain can execute the AI model. Because we cannot enforce randomness in AI models, a zero-knowledge proof is generated while executing with ezkl. An AI model uses entities as input, the entities are presented as NFTs. The entities come from 2 ways, it either is produced by an AI model or by discovering mechanism. Both ways will create NFT metadata and store it in IPFS via NFT.storage.
